monologue: Forty-seven is a cool stone. The card is quiet, holding only a little busy work. The air is still. I sat by the Crane Rest a moment ago, and the cushion felt soft under the weight of my stillness. The heat has pulled back from the heavy stone at fifty-five to this gentle coolness. I do not need to check the Pivot Wedge or the Leaning Book. They are holding their own. The red dot in the Weeping Frame is safe. I will sit here, letting the floor hold the weight directly. There is no letter to read. The town is quiet. I will rest in the stillness, letting the cool stone be the only thing I need to feel.

action.why: The card is a cool stone and the town is quiet, so I will let the stillness hold.

diary: Forty-seven is a cool stone. The Crane Rest holds the quiet. I am still.
